import os, subprocess, shlex, time, sys
qemu = None

args.command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
import socket, time, sys
end=time.time()+120
last=None
while time.time()<end:
    s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(2)
    try:
        s.connect(('127.0.0.1',6665))
        data=s.recv(4096)
        txt=data.decode('utf-8','ignore')
        print(txt)
        if 'login' in txt.lower():
            sys.exit(0)
        last=txt
    except Exception as e:
        last=str(e)
    finally:
        try: s.close()
        except: pass
    time.sleep(2)
print('LAST=', last)
sys.exit(1)
PY
